{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Nothing in this galaxy is harder to trick than a Sith High Lord.|[[Sarasu Taalon]], High Lord of the Sith Lost Tribe|<ref name="vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
A '''High Lord''' was a presiding member on the [[Circle of Lords]], the ruling council of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. They held their meetings in the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. There were seven High Lords on the Circle; they ranked above the thirteen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] that sat on the Circle, but below the [[Grand Lord]]. There were a total of seven High Lords at a time in the Lost Tribe.<ref name="ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

As of [[41 ABY]], two of the High Lords were female; they were addressed as "Lady."
